name: Barbell Bench Press
targetMuscles: Pectoralis Major, Triceps Brachii, Anterior Deltoids
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with eyes directly under the racked bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width, plant feet firmly on the floor.
Unrack and lower with control down to the mid-chest.
Press powerfully upward without locking out elbows aggressively.
coachTips: Retract shoulder blades and maintain a slight natural arch in the lower back.
Drive through your heels for stability.
breathingTip: Inhale on the descent; exhale forcefully on the press.
progressionNote: Add 2.5kg when you complete 4x10 reps with solid form.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Sit on the edge of a flat bench holding dumbbells on knees.
Kick back and bring the weights to the outside of your chest.
Press dumbbells up in a slight arc until arms are extended.
Lower slowly until elbows reach bench height.
coachTips: Allows a deeper stretch than barbells and balances side-to-side asymmetries.
breathingTip: Breathe in deeply as dumbbells lower; exhale as you push up.
progressionNote: Progress by 1-2 kg per dumbbell when hitting the top rep range.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to a 30 to 45 degree angle.
Lie back and press dumbbells above upper chest.
Lower slowly until you feel a comfortable stretch in the upper pectorals.
Press back up smoothly.
commonMistakes: Setting incline too steep turning it into shoulder press
coachTips: 30 degrees is optimal to hit upper chest without straining anterior delts.
breathingTip: Inhale on the way down; exhale as you press up.
progressionNote: Aim for clean controlled 3-second negatives before raising load.

name: Standard Push-Up
instructions: Start in high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower chest towards floor by bending elbows back at 45 degrees.
Push floor away firmly to return to starting position.
coachTips: Squeeze glutes and brace your core throughout every rep.
breathingTip: Inhale going down; exhale pushing up.
progressionNote: Elevate feet to progress towards decline push-ups.

name: Incline Push-Up (Joint-Friendly)
instructions: Place hands shoulder-width apart on a sturdy bench or raised platform.
Keep spine aligned as you lower your chest to the bench edge.
Push away to full arm extension.
coachTips: Excellent alternative if you have wrist stiffness or shoulder impingement.
breathingTip: Smooth breathing in sync with repetitions.
progressionNote: Lower the platform height progressively to reach the floor.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press (Shoulder Safe)
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold dumbbells with triceps resting on the floor.
Press weights up until arms are extended over chest.
Lower slowly until upper arms lightly touch the floor, pause briefly, repeat.
coachTips: The floor limits shoulder extension, protecting the anterior capsule.
progressionNote: Increase weight once you can complete 12 clean reps with 1s pause.

name: Cable Chest Flye
instructions: Set cables at chest height, grab handles and step forward in a split stance.
With slightly bent elbows, bring handles together in a hugging motion.
Squeeze chest for 1 second, then control back to a stretch.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much turning it into a press
coachTips: Imagine hugging a large barrel to keep arm angle locked.
breathingTip: Exhale on contraction; inhale on stretch.
progressionNote: Focus on mind-muscle squeeze rather than maximum pin weight.

name: Chest Dips
instructions: Mount parallel bars and lean your torso slightly forward (30 degrees).
Lower body by bending elbows until upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Push back up focusing on chest activation.
commonMistakes: Staying upright (targets triceps more than chest)
Going too deep into shoulder impingement
coachTips: Keep chin tucked and cross ankles for balance.
progressionNote: Add a dip belt with 2.5-5kg when bodyweight reaches 3x12.
